name: release-teaser
title: Release Teaser
description: A sixteen-second release announcement: five short statements resolve from the center outward over an extreme close-up of a dark, beveled open ring, then the camera pulls back to the ring behind the release lockup and the light recedes while the name holds. Silent: sound is added by the host.
useWhen: A sixteen-second release announcement built on anticipation and a final brand reveal.
The story fits five short statements, with a dimensional mark as the visual thread.
avoidWhen: The video must show real product interactions and workflows: use launch-anything.
You want to introduce a whole palette, typography and photography system: use brand-guidelines.
author: Remocn
